proposals.evidence: DEDR4275 explicitly gives Kurux punā new and Malto pune. Survey pune/buna are comparative same-language new adjectives preserving final-vowel and initial labial voicing; they are distinct from Indo-Aryan nava-type responses. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
